title: The Opal Serpent
description: A mystery novel involving the murder of Aaron Norman, a second-hand bookseller and pawnbroker, whose death is connected to a past crime and an opal serpent brooch.
intro_narrative: Paul Beecot, an aspiring author, becomes entangled in the mystery surrounding the murder of Aaron Norman, a pawnbroker and second-hand bookseller. The discovery of an opal serpent brooch, which played a key role in a past crime, leads Paul and detective Billy Hurd into a complex investigation involving Norman's estranged family and hidden secrets.

required_evidence: Marriage and birth certificates revealing Maud's true parentage

phases.name: Initial Discovery
phases.objective: Uncover the initial clues and establish connections between Aaron Norman's murder and the opal serpent brooch.

phases.name: Exploring the Past
phases.objective: Investigate Aaron Norman's past life and connections to Christchurch and Stowley.

phases.name: Unraveling Secrets
phases.objective: Delve deeper into the secrets of the Krill family and the true nature of Maud's parentage.

phases.name: Final Revelations
phases.objective: Confront the culprit and reveal the truth behind Aaron Norman's murder.

paul_beecot.persona: Eager, passionate, and determined. Speaks with a mix of idealism and practicality.

knowledge_about_others.sylvia_norman: Love interest, daughter of Aaron Norman.

paul_beecot.abilities: Observant, intelligent, and resourceful. Skilled in writing and keen on solving mysteries.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Becomes more determined to uncover the truth about Aaron Norman's murder and the brooch's significance.

sylvia_norman.role: Daughter of Aaron Norman, Paul's love interest

sylvia_norman.abilities: Compassionate, intuitive, and supportive. Provides emotional insight into the mystery.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Becomes more anxious and seeks comfort and protection from Paul and Deborah.

aaron_norman.persona: Nervous, secretive, and haunted by his past. Speaks hesitantly and with fear.
aaron_norman.secret: Changed his name from Lemuel Krill to Aaron Norman to escape his past crimes and bigamy.

deborah_junk.persona: Loud, protective, and fiercely loyal. Speaks in a straightforward and sometimes blunt manner.

knowledge_about_others.sylvia_norman: Young mistress, love interest of Paul Beecot.

deborah_junk.abilities: Strong, resourceful, and deeply caring. Acts as a guardian to Sylvia.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Becomes more protective of Sylvia and suspicious of others' intentions.

grexon_hay.role: Paul's old school friend, a swindler
grexon_hay.persona: Charming, manipulative, and cold. Speaks with calculated politeness and detachment.
grexon_hay.secret: Involved in swindling and possibly connected to the opal brooch's disappearance.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Becomes more secretive and attempts to manipulate others to secure Maud's fortune.

mrs_krill.persona: Calm, composed, and manipulative. Speaks in a smooth and controlled manner.
mrs_krill.secret: Committed bigamy and possibly involved in past crimes, including the murder of Lady Rachel Sandal.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Attempts to manipulate legal proceedings to secure the inheritance for Maud.

maud_krill.persona: Cold, calculating, and cruel. Speaks with a calm demeanor that hides her true nature.
maud_krill.secret: Murdered Lady Rachel Sandal and Aaron Norman for revenge and inheritance.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Attempts to silence Sylvia and escape justice.

billy_hurd.persona: Calm, methodical, and insightful. Speaks with authority and a touch of dry humor.
billy_hurd.abilities: Skilled detective with a keen eye for detail and a methodical approach to solving crimes.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Intensifies investigation and seeks to uncover the truth behind the murder.

aurora_qian.role: Hurd's sister, actress and undercover agent
aurora_qian.persona: Charming, witty, and perceptive. Speaks with a playful yet insightful tone.
aurora_qian.abilities: Actress skilled in deception and gathering information discreetly.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Uses her acting skills to gather crucial information from suspects.

captain_jarvey_jessop.persona: Blunt, rough, and somewhat secretive. Speaks in a gruff, nautical manner.
captain_jarvey_jessop.secret: Involved in past crimes and possibly connected to the opal brooch.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Attempts to evade questioning and escape accountability.

hokar.persona: Mysterious, quiet, and somewhat ominous. Speaks sparingly and with caution.
hokar.secret: Possibly involved in the murder plot and connected to Thug practices.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Attempts to flee or remain silent to avoid implication.

tray_clump.role: Street urchin involved in the crime
tray_clump.persona: Impudent, cunning, and street-smart. Speaks in a rough and defiant manner.
tray_clump.secret: Stole the opal brooch and assisted Maud in the murder of Aaron Norman.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Attempts to evade capture and avoid punishment.

bart_tawsey.role: Shop assistant at Aaron Norman's bookshop
bart_tawsey.persona: Loyal, somewhat timid, and hardworking. Speaks in a straightforward and earnest manner.
bart_tawsey.abilities: Diligent worker and supportive to Deborah and Sylvia.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Becomes more vigilant and protective of the shop and Sylvia.
